fields.System.Title: INV-603 — FEFO ordering of candidate stock
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want candidate stock returned earliest-expiry-first, so that
allocation and replenishment ship the oldest dated stock before it expires unsold.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given several batches of an expiry-tracked product, when candidates are requested,
  • then they are ordered by expiry date ascending.
  • - Given a product with no expiry tracking, then candidates are ordered by receipt date
  • ascending — FIFO.
  • - Given a location holding two batches, then ordering is applied at batch level, not
  • location level.
  • - Given an expired batch, then it does not appear among candidates at all.
  • - Given equal expiry dates, then the tie is broken deterministically so results are
  • repeatable.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, batch |
| Risks | FEFO applied at location level ships the wrong batch ([doc 09 §4.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
